metadata.title: Delegated Send‑As / Send‑On‑Behalf SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining trust boundaries, authority semantics, and accountability controls for delegated email sending (Send‑As and Send‑On‑Behalf).

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security, privacy, identity, records, and regulatory baseline.

system-characteristics.system-description: Institutional email capability allowing permitted individuals to send email on behalf of another mailbox or role under explicit, auditable, and time‑bound delegation.

information-type.title: Delegated Email Message Content
information-type.description: Messages sent using Send‑As or Send‑On‑Behalf delegation, including identity and authority context.

information-type.title: Delegation State and Authority Records
information-type.description: Records defining who is authorized to send on behalf of which mailbox or role and under what conditions.

information-type.title: Delegated Send Audit Events
information-type.description: Audit records binding each delegated message to both the acting individual and the represented mailbox or role.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Delegated sending inherits authority and lifecycle semantics from Role‑Based Mailbox SSPP.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Delegated sending extends Shared Mailbox attribution and audit constraints.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Delegated sending is implemented on the Secure Email Platform.

props.name: usage-intent
props.remarks: Delegated Send‑As and Send‑On‑Behalf are intended for explicit human delegation scenarios only.

props.name: delegation-model
props.remarks: Delegation MUST be explicitly requested, approved, and documented prior to use.

props.name: delegation-scope
props.remarks: Delegated sending authority MUST be limited to the minimum scope required.

props.name: delegation-duration
props.remarks: Delegated sending authority MUST be time‑bounded and automatically expire unless renewed.

props.name: delegation-review
props.remarks: All delegated sending permissions MUST be periodically reviewed and re‑attested.

props.name: send-as-constraint
props.remarks: Send‑As delegation is permitted only where Send‑On‑Behalf is insufficient and requires elevated approval.

props.name: send-on-behalf-preference
props.remarks: Send‑On‑Behalf is the preferred delegation mode to preserve identity transparency.

props.name: identity-transparency
props.remarks: Recipients MUST be able to determine both the acting sender and the represented mailbox or role.

props.name: external-forwarding
props.remarks: Delegated sending MUST NOT be combined with external forwarding under any circumstance.

props.name: automation-constraint
props.remarks: Delegated Send‑As and Send‑On‑Behalf MUST NOT be used by applications, scripts, or automated processes.

props.name: auditability
props.remarks: All delegated messages MUST be auditable with attribution to both the acting individual and the delegated identity.

props.name: data-classification-constraint
props.remarks: Delegated sending MUST NOT be used for information classified at Level 4 or higher.

props.name: disclosure-authority
props.remarks: Disclosure of delegated email content occurs only under lawful or formally authorized institutional processes.

system-implementation.remarks: Delegated sending trust is enforced through explicit approval workflows, strong identity binding, dual attribution logging, and centralized monitoring.

components.title: Delegated Email Sending Capability
components.description: Capability enabling controlled Send‑As and Send‑On‑Behalf email under strict governance.

roles.title: Delegation Approving Authority
roles.remarks: Authorizes and revokes delegated sending authority.

roles.title: Delegated Sender
roles.remarks: Individual authorized to send email on behalf of another mailbox or role.

control-implementation.remarks: All controls applicable to delegated sending are inherited from Role‑Based Mailbox SSPP, Shared Mailbox SSPP, and Secure Email Platform SSPP with added approval, attribution, and lifecycle constraints.
